name: Extremadura
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

known.via: English Wikipedia "Extremadura wine" (redirects to "Extremadura (Vino de la Tierra)")

terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
A single-estate wine of high quality. A pago is a vineyard estate.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A broad Spanish Vino de la Tierra covering every municipality in the Extremadura region. It is one step below the main Denominación de Origen level, and Cayetana Blanca and Tempranillo are the most planted grapes.
